_doc: Automatic YouTube playlist sorting (tools/yt_playlists.py, daily via .github/workflows/playlists.yml). First matching rule wins. Shorts (#shorts) are skipped. Match = all 'all' words and at least one 'any' word (case-insensitive) in the title, and none of 'not'.

playlists.title: Black & White Baby Sensory (90 min)
playlists.description: High-contrast black & white sensory videos for newborns and babies, 90 minutes of calm original music. All music and animation is original.

playlists.title: Calm Videos for Babies & Toddlers (90 min)
playlists.description: Long, calm videos with gentle animals and soft original music – for quiet time, tummy time and bedtime. All music and animation is original.
